name: Graceful Calm (Ki)
body:
Your smooth grace keeps your mind focused even amid danger.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation

Benefit(s): As long as you have at least 1 point in your ki pool, you gain a +1 bonus to concentration checks. This stacks with the bonus from Ignore Distraction. As a swift action when casting a spell, you can spend 1 point from your ki pool to add your Dexterity bonus to concentration checks made to cast defensively. Alternatively, you may choose to add your Wisdom bonus as a dodge bonus to your Armor Class against attacks of opportunity provoked by casting that spell.
